primary_interpretation: Compare within each domain and label scope; do not pool simulation, live faults, integrity controls or external packet labels
basic_label_correction: Supervised behavior labels exclude integrity-only and invisible episodes; train known behavior, retain held-out sequence
external_note: One normal capture and one attack capture per family; folds are transfer between two sessions, not independent population repeats
safety_scope: Live native procedures and local process availability faults; profile/MAC corruption controls use offline copies only
success_condition: Execution, provenance, evidence and invariants; no positive performance result is required
not_implemented_note: No result is attributed to unimplemented architectures; feedforward MLP and learned relation features are not those architectures
